intermediate_answers.answer: Apple's R&D spending is reported in aggregate in SEC filings and financial disclosures. While Project Titan (Apple's car project) has been a known initiative since at least 2016, Apple does not publicly disclose granular, project-specific R&D budgets in its financial reports. The evidence confirms that Apple maintains extreme secrecy regarding its internal projects.

Evidence indicates that Apple's 'Project Titan' (the self-driving car project) was definitively shut down in April 2024. Consequently, there is no internal R&D budget for this project in the fiscal year 2035, as the project no longer exists.

answer.raw_answer:
## Summary
There is no internal R&D budget for Apple's "Project Titan" in fiscal year 2035 because the initiative was definitively shut down in April 2024. Furthermore, Apple does not publicly disclose granular, project-specific R&D budgets in its financial filings, maintaining a policy of extreme corporate secrecy regarding its internal development costs.

## Status of Project Titan
Project Titan, Apple's long-standing initiative to develop an autonomous electric vehicle, is no longer an active project.

<details>
<summary>Project cancellation details</summary>

Apple officially shut down Project Titan in April 2024. The decision was driven by a strategic pivot to prioritize the development of generative artificial intelligence technologies. Following the cancellation, approximately 2,000 employees previously assigned to the project were largely transferred to Apple's AI division [Autopromotec Blog - Artificial intelligence pulls the plug on Project Titan: Apple says goodbye to iCar — www.autopromotec.com](https://www.autopromotec.com/en/Artificial-intelligence-pulls-the-plug-on-Project-Titan-Apple-says-goodbye-to/a970).
</details>

## Apple's R&D Financial Disclosure Practices
Apple does not provide itemized R&D budgets for specific internal projects in its public financial disclosures.

<details>
<summary>Analysis of Apple's financial reporting and secrecy</summary>

Apple reports its research and development spending in aggregate within its financial statements. While the company has seen its total R&D expenditure rise significantly—reaching $11.4 billion in the second fiscal quarter of 2026—these figures are not broken down by individual project [Apple's R&D spending hits new record as AI investment ramps up — 9to5mac.com](https://9to5mac.com/2026/04/30/apples-rd-spending-hits-new-record-as-ai-investment-ramps-up).

Apple maintains an intensely secretive corporate culture to protect its product pipeline. This culture includes rigorous screening processes and specialized security teams designed to prevent leaks of confidential information [Apple internal presentation about fighting leaks was leaked — mashable.com](https://mashable.com/article/apple-secrecy-structure-leaked). Because of this, even when the company was actively pursuing Project Titan, specific budget allocations for the project were never publicly disclosed [Apple triples R&D budget to $10bn for biggest pivot yet: Project Titan — www.siliconrepublic.com](https://www.siliconrepublic.com/companies/apple-rd-pivot-project-titan-electric-car).
</details>

## Market Context for 2035
While Apple is no longer involved in the autonomous vehicle market, the broader industry continues to grow.

<details>
<summary>Autonomous vehicle market outlook</summary>

The global autonomous vehicle development platform market is projected to grow significantly between 2026 and 2035. Industry analysts forecast the market size to reach approximately $380.3 billion by 2035, driven by advancements in AI, machine learning, and simulation infrastructure [Autonomous Vehicle Development Platform Market, 2035 Report — www.gminsights.com](https://www.gminsights.com/industry-analysis/autonomous-vehicle-development-platform-market).

| Metric | Data |
| :--- | :--- |
| 2025 Market Size | USD 46.8 Billion |
| 2026 Market Size | USD 60.5 Billion |
| 2035 Forecast Market Size | USD 380.3 Billion |
| CAGR (2026–2035) | 22.7% |

*Source: [Autonomous Vehicle Development Platform Market, 2035 Report — www.gminsights.com](https://www.gminsights.com/industry-analysis/autonomous-vehicle-development-platform-market)*
</details>

## Key Takeaways
*   **Project Status:** Project Titan was cancelled in April 2024; therefore, no budget exists for it in 2035.
*   **Disclosure Policy:** Apple does not publicly report project-specific R&D spending, providing only aggregate figures in its financial reports.
*   **Strategic Shift:** Apple has redirected its resources and personnel from automotive development toward generative AI, which is now a primary focus for the company's future investment.
